entries.title: Original game visual data internal production authorization
entries.authorizationSource: Owner directives recorded in the Codex project task on 2026-09-01
notes: This entry truthfully records the Owner's instruction to complete internal production before whole-product visual review.
Internal authorization is not represented as a substitute for a signed licence or release approval.
The faithful baseline may be directly bound in a non-public internal build without a user-facing loader; ROM and Nitro source payloads remain excluded from the repository and every public release.
It does not claim that a signed licence document has been received or legally reviewed.
Runtime registration and release require a linked, hashed, and verified private document.
